title: Justin's Ice
description: Justin's Ice aims to improve the ice and snow biomes by introducing new entities, blocks, structures, and items, without straying too far from vanilla minecraft.
body: Justin's Ice aims to improve the ice and snow biomes by introducing new entities, blocks, structures, and items, without straying too far from vanilla minecraft. This is an early version of the mod, and it will be improved with time. Currently, the mod adds one new entity, two new structures, a new plant/crop, a new potion type, 3 new weapons, and many new fun features. This is the first version of Justin's Ice, so it does not include everything I wanted to include, but I will update it over time.
